basic_info.description: This Bernal Heights turnkey corner house has a beautiful updated kitchen and bathroom, a backyard with fruit trees, and a spacious garage. It is detached on 3 sides and has curb appeal, charm, and character. Great natural light and a flexible layout. Nice sized kitchen and living and dining areas. The bright kitchen looks out to the backyard from the window above the sink. The office has a view of the backyard as well. Comfortable bedrooms and a bathroom complete this level. The stunning bathroom features a skylight. Gorgeous floors, light fixtures, and period details. Walkout backyard is convenient for outdoor entertaining. The inviting backyard has mature fruit trees and space for dining and lounging. Interior access to the garage and lower level which offers space for a variety of uses. The garage has an EV charger and ample storage space. Located by Holly Park, St. Mary's Recreation Center, and Bernal Heights Park. Enjoy being near numerous popular restaurants, cafes, shops, and nightlife on Cortland Ave. and Mission St. Quick access to 101 and 280. Bernal Heights is a beloved neighborhood for its weather, community, walkability, and proximity to Noe Valley, the Mission, and Glen Park. Opportunity to buy a move-in ready house in a desirable location for the price of a condo.
